classes.BENEFICIAL_REINFORCEMENT: same semantic function plus concrete method/example/qualifier; keep
classes.REDUNDANT_DUPLICATION: same operation, scope, qualifier, and effect with no added detail; omit supplement member before closure finalization
classes.DETAIL_ENRICHMENT: original section adds concrete fields/behavior to baseline abstraction; keep
classes.QUALIFIER_RESTORATION: restores cost, observability, order, limitation, or boundary; keep
classes.ANTI_PATTERN_RESTORATION: adds prohibited pattern plus correction; keep

dedupe_key: semantic function + operation + scope + qualifiers + effect + authority level
